abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the association between subfertility in men and the subsequent risk of testicular cancer. DESIGN: Population based case-control study. SETTING: The Danish population. PARTICIPANTS: Cases were identified in the Danish Cancer Registry; controls were randomly selected from the Danish population with the computerised Danish Central Population Register. Men were interviewed by telephone; 514 men with cancer and 720 controls participated. OUTCOME MEASURE: Occurrence of testicular cancer. RESULTS: A reduced risk of testicular cancer was associated with paternity (relative risk 0.63; 95% confidence interval 0.47 to 0.85). In men who before the diagnosis of testicular cancer had a lower number of children than expected on the basis of their age, the relative risk was 1.98 (1.43 to 2.75). There was no corresponding protective effect associated with a higher number of children than expected. The associations were similar for seminoma and non-seminoma and were not influenced by adjustment for potential confounding factors. CONCLUSION: These data are consistent with the hypothesis that male subfertility and testicular cancer share important aetiological factors.
abstract_ja:
目的：男性の不妊と、その後の精巣がんのリスクとの関連を評価すること。
デザイン：集団ベースの症例対照研究。
設定：デンマークの集団。
対象：症例はデンマーク癌登録から同定し、対照はデンマーク中央人口登録から無作為抽出した。男性には電話で面接を実施し、がん患者514人と対照720人が参加した。
評価項目：精巣がんの発生。
結果：父親であることは精巣がんのリスク低下と関連していた(相対危険度0.63、95%信頼区間0.47～0.85)。診断前の子どもの数が年齢から期待される数より少ない男性では、相対危険度は1.98(1.43～2.75)であった。子どもの数が期待より多いことによる同様の防御効果は認められなかった。セミノーマと非セミノーマで関連は類似しており、潜在的交絡因子で調整しても結果は変わらなかった。
結論：これらのデータは、男性の不妊と精巣がんが重要な病因因子を共有するという仮説と一致する。
